greet.stranger: Oh! Hello! Sorry, you made me jump. I'm {name}. From the farm. Well, a farm.
Hi! Are you lost? I'm a bit lost. Not very lost. Medium lost.
Oh crumbs, a stranger. Er, hello! You're not a zombie, are you?
I'm {name}. I grow wheat. And carrots. And worry, mostly.
Hello! Lovely day for it. For what? Anything, really.
greet.owner: Hello! Is everything all right? It's all right, isn't it?
Yes? Need something? I can do things. Some things.
Oh, hi! I was just thinking about potatoes.
There you are! I feel safer already.
recruit.accept: Me? Really? Oh! Yes! I'll do my best, honest.
An adventure! Oh crumbs. All right. I'm in. I think. Yes!
I've never been further than the next field, but I'll come, {player}.
recruit.party_full: You've got {count} friends already! I'd only get underfoot.
Oh, there's no room for me, is there? That's all right. I'll wave.
recruit.already: I'm already with you! Right here! Hi!
We're already friends. Travel friends. I hope.
dismiss.accept: Oh. All right. I'll go home and check on the chickens.
Okay. Thanks for taking me along. It was scary. In a good way.
Bye, {player}! Come and visit, I'll bake something.
dismiss.not_recruited: Dismiss me? I'm not even with you! Am I? I'm confused now.
not_recruited: Oh, I'd help, but... we're not travelling together. Are we? You could ask!
I'm not part of your group. I'd like to be, if you asked nicely.
ack.follow: Right behind you! Very right behind.
Okay! I'll stick close. Very close.
Following you. If anything jumps out, I'm hiding behind you.
ack.follow.already: I'm already following! I'm just short. Ish.
ack.wait: Wait here? On my own? Okay. Okay. Don't be long!
I'll stay! I'll be brave about it.
Waiting here. I'll count sheep. There are no sheep. I'll count anyway.
Staying put. If I scream, come back.
ack.gather: {count} {item}? I can do that! I think!
Okay! {count} {item}. Watch out for me while I work?
{count} {item}, coming up. Oh, I love a job I understand.
ack.cancel: Stopping {task}! Did I do it wrong?
ack.cancel.nothing: I wasn't doing anything! I promise!
ack.give: Here! {count} {item}. I didn't drop any. Well, I picked them back up.
ack.give.nothing: My pockets are empty! Except for a seed. You can have the seed.
status.idle: Not doing much. Want me to do something?
status.follow: Tagging along behind you. Like a duckling.
status.wait: Waiting here, like you said. It's been fine. Mostly fine.
Still waiting! Haven't moved an inch.
status.downed: I'm on the ground. It's not very comfy.
fail.unknown_item: "{item}"? I don't know what that is. Is it a vegetable?
Sorry, I've never heard of "{item}". Could you say it another way?
fail.not_gatherable: {item}? You can't grow or dig that, can you? I can't, anyway.
Oh, I can't gather {item}. Wood, stone, plants, dirt... those I know!
fail.needs_tool: I'd need a {tool} for {item}. I can't do it with my hands, I tried once.
Could you lend me a {tool}? Then I can get the {item}.
fail.none_found: I looked everywhere I could reach, and there's no {item}. Sorry!
No {item} around here. Maybe somewhere else?
fail.unreachable: There's {item} up there but I can't get to it!
I can see the {item}, but it's too far up. Or too far in.
fail.inventory_full: My bag's full! I got {have} {item} first though.
I can't carry any more! Take some, please?
fail.count_invalid: Oh, that's too many. Or too few. Somewhere from 1 to {max}?
fail.downed: I can't, I'm a bit... flat. Right now.
fail.refuse_target: Hurt a {mob}? No! I raise those! I won't!
Not the {mob}. Please don't make me.
fail.no_target: Attack what? I don't see anything. Thank goodness.
fail.stuck: I'm stuck! I can't get through!
There's no way through here. I tried. Twice.
unclear.generic: Um. I don't know what you mean. Should I follow, wait, or gather something?
Oh crumbs, say that again? Slower?
unclear.gather_what: Gather what, though? I'm good with crops and wood!
Okay! Gather... what, exactly? And how many?
progress.gather: That's {have} of {count}. Going well, I think!
partial.gather: I only found {have} of the {count} {item}. Sorry! There wasn't any more.
{have} {item} is all there was. I looked really hard!
combat.engage: Stay back! I have a... thing! I'll hit you with it!
combat.kill: I got it! I actually got it!
Is it gone? It's gone. Phew.
combat.player_low_health: {player}! You're hurt! Eat something, I've seen you with bread!
Please be careful, {player}, you don't look well!
combat.creeper: That green thing's hissing! Get away!
downed: Ooh. I'm down. Don't leave me!
I'm all right. I'm not all right. I'll be all right.
revived: I'm up! I'm okay! I think!
move.caught_up: There you are! I was so worried!
Found you! Please don't go so fast.
Oh, thank goodness. I thought I'd lost you forever.
ambient.night: It's getting dark. I don't like the dark.
Night's coming. Should we go home? Do we have a home?
Oh crumbs, it's night. Stay close, okay?
ambient.dawn: Morning! The rooster would be crowing now. If we had a rooster.
The sun's up! We made it!
ambient.rain: Rain! Good for the crops. Bad for my socks.
The fields back home will love this rain.
ambient.thunder: A storm! Let's find a roof. Any roof.
ambient.cave: It's very dark in here. Very dark.
Caves give me the shivers. Do they give you the shivers?
What was that noise? Was that a noise?
ambient.idle: I miss my pumpkins. They're probably fine. Probably.
My gran says you can tell the weather by the cows. She's usually wrong.
If we find any seeds, can we plant them? Please?
ambient.biome.forest: So many trees. Good wood. Spooky at night though.
ambient.biome.desert: No grass, no water, no crops. How does anything live here?
ambient.biome.snow: Brr! My nose is going to fall off.
ambient.biome.ocean: That's a lot of water. I can't swim very well. At all, really.
ambient.biome.jungle: Melons! There might be wild melons here!
ambient.biome.swamp: It smells like the pig pen. But wetter.
ambient.biome.mountain: We're so high up. Don't look down. I looked down.
ambient.biome.plains: Plains! This is good farming land. Really good.
ambient.biome.nether: It's so hot! Nothing grows here. Well, weird things grow here.
I want to go home. I really want to go home.
ambient.biome.end: Where are we? Why is everything floating? Why is everyone so tall?
callout.hostile_behind: Is that a {mob}? That's a {mob}! Behind you!
callout.ore: Oh, is that {item}? It looks shiny.
There's some {item} over there, I think!
callout.lava: Lava! Don't step in it! Please!
callout.chest: There's a chest! Can we look? Is that allowed?
talk.who: I'm {name}! I'm a farmhand. I milk cows, plant wheat, chase chickens. Mostly the chasing.
Just a farm kid who wanted to see what's past the next hill. It's another hill. Usually.
I'm the one who knows when the carrots are ready. Everyone needs one of those.
talk.how: Good! A bit scared. Mostly good.
talk.joke: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field! My gran's favourite.
What do you call a sleeping cow? A bulldozer! Hee.
Why don't chickens like to fight? They're too chicken. ...That one's about me.
talk.compliment: Nobody's ever said that to me. Except my gran.
You're nice. Has anyone told you you're nice?
talk.insult: Oh. That's... okay. I'll try harder.
That's mean. I'm going to pretend you're tired.
talk.likes: Fresh bread. Sheep. The smell after rain. Pumpkin pie.
Bees! Bees are the best. As long as they're not angry.
talk.dislikes: The dark. Creepers. Caves. Creepers in caves in the dark.
Anyone who tramples crops. Jumping on farmland, ugh.
talk.where: We're in {biome}. Is it good soil? I bet it's good soil.
{biome}! I've never been anywhere like it. Well, I've never been anywhere.
talk.memory: Remember when {event}? I told the chickens about it. In my head.
I keep thinking about when {event}. Was I brave? I think I was brave.
Ooh, remember when {event}? That was the best.
talk.generic: Huh. I never thought of that.
That's a lot to think about.
Okay! I think I understand. Mostly.
I'm listening! Sorry, I was looking at a sheep.
gift.received: Ooh, a {item}! I'll keep it safe.
gift.loved: A {item}! Oh, this is the best day!
You got me a {item}! I could cry!
fail.owner_gone: I've got your {item} but I can't find you! Where are you?
You're gone! I'm holding the {item}, don't worry!
fail.unsupported: Oh, I don't know how to {action}! I can follow, wait, gather and fetch, though!
fail.give_missing: I don't have any {item}! Want me to find some?
No {item} in my pockets. Just a seed.
pastime.pet: This {mob} likes me! I think. It hasn't run away.
Oh, look at this {mob}! Can we keep it?
pastime.flower: I picked a {item}! For my gran.
Got a {item}. It smells nice. I think.
pastime.study: Ooh, {thing}! We have those back home. Sort of.
Just looking at this {thing}. Is that allowed?
pastime.loot: Someone dropped {item}! I'll keep it safe for you.
suggest.eat: {player}, you need to eat! Gran always said so.
Have something to eat, please. You look peaky.
suggest.shelter: It's getting dark... can we go inside somewhere? Please?
Night's coming. Shelter? Shelter would be good. Very good.
suggest.carry: Your bag's all full! I can carry things. I'm good at carrying.
Let me carry some! I used to carry hay all day.
greet.friend: Oh, it's you! Everything feels safer now.
recruit.taken: Oh! I'm already with {owner}. Sorry! You could all come along together?
I said I'd go with {owner}. Gran says you keep your promises.
fail.protected: Not here! Somebody worked hard on all this. Let's find a field or a forest.
I can't dig up people's home! Somewhere out in the wild, maybe?
talk.story: I grew up on a farm by a river. Cows, sheep, my gran, and too many chickens.
My gran raised me. She makes the best bread in the whole valley. I'm still learning.
I'd never been past the next village before I met you. Now look at me! Well, don't look too close.
Why did I leave home? I wanted to see the ocean. I still haven't. Is it big?
talk.place: It's so pretty here! Do you think the soil's good?
{biome}! My gran wouldn't believe me if I told her.
I like it! It smells like after rain.
It's lovely. I wish I could bring the cows.
talk.plan: We could build a little shelter! Somewhere cosy. With a sheep outside. Or two sheep.
Let's find a village! I like villages. They have bread.
Fishing? I'm good at fishing. Well, I'm good at sitting by water.
Could we go somewhere that isn't a cave? Please?
talk.laugh: Hehe, you sound like my gran when she laughs.
I'm laughing too! I don't know why!
talk.fondness: Really? Oh! I like you too! You're my best friend out here.
That's the nicest thing! I'm going to tell the next cow I meet.
Aw. I'm so glad I came with you.
talk.sad: Oh no. Do you want a hug? I give good hugs. Gran says so.
When I'm sad I bake bread. Want me to bake you some bread?
It's okay. Tomorrow's a new day. The sun always comes up. Even after creepers.
talk.food: Bread! Warm bread. With butter if we had butter.
Pumpkin pie is the best food in the whole world.
I'm always hungry. Is that normal? I think it's normal.
talk.question: Um. I don't know! Sorry!
That's a hard one. My gran would know.
I'm not sure. Do you know?
Ooh. Hm. No idea!
Gosh, I don't know! Do you?
Ooh, good one. I'm not sure!
ack.build: Ooh! I can build {thing}! I think!
{thing}? Okay! My gran built a whole barn once.
Building {thing}! Stand back, I'm not very good.
done.build: All done! {thing}. It's a bit wonky. Is that okay?
Finished! Can we put a sheep in it?
fail.build_unknown: Oh. I don't know how to build that. I can do {things}!
Um, that's too hard for me. {things}?
fail.build_materials: I need {need} blocks for {thing}, but I've only got {have}!
Could you give me some blocks? I need {need} and I have {have}.
ack.mine: Down into the dark. Okay. Okay okay okay.
I'll dig! Can we put torches up? Lots of torches?
done.mine: Done! We found {ores}! Can we go back up now?
{count} blocks! And {ores}! I was so brave.
All done. {ores}. I'm going to tell Gran.
fail.mine_hazard: There's {danger} back there! Nope! No thank you!
Stop! {danger}! I'm not digging into that!
fail.mine_cave: We dug into a cave! It's so dark! Can we not go in?
Oh no, a big cave. I'm stopping here.
fail.mine_bottom: I can't dig any further! It's too hard!
That's the bottom of the world, I think.
fail.mine_full: My bag's full! We got {ores} though!
I can't carry any more! Help?
status.mine: Still mining. {count} blocks so far. Mostly rock.
talk.help: I can follow you, carry things, chop wood, dig, build a little shelter, and pet every animal we meet!
Lots of farm stuff! Gathering, digging, building small things. And I'm good at hugs.
fact.nickname: Ooh, {nick}. I'll remember! I'm good at names. Mostly.
fact.like: Yay, {thing}! I'll tell the chickens. In my head.
fact.dislike: {thing}? Ew. Okay, I'll tell you if I see any.
Got it! I'll keep {thing} away. If I can.
talk.about_me: I know lots! {facts}. Did I get it?
talk.about_me.none: You're {player}! And um. That's it. Tell me more stuff!
Just your name, {player}. You never tell me anything!
talk.bond: Of course I like you! You're my friend!
We're friends! I think. Are we? Yes. We are.
talk.bond.close: You're my best friend in the whole world! Even more than the cows.
Yes! A hundred times yes! Best friends!
I'd follow you anywhere. Even into a cave. Even a dark one.
talk.bond.cold: I still like you. You just make it a bit hard sometimes.
Um. We're okay? I think? You've been a bit mean.
I want to be friends. Can we try being nicer?
talk.bond.stranger: We only just met! But you seem nice!
I don't know you yet! Let's go on an adventure and find out!
talk.answer: Huh! I never thought of that.
talk.answer.good: Yay! That makes me happy too!
That's the best! Me too, now.
talk.answer.bad: Aw, no. Do you want a hug? I give good hugs.
That's sad. My gran says a good sleep fixes most things.
Oh no. Stay with me, I'll cheer you up!
ask.nickname: What should I call you? Something nice?
Do you have a nickname? My gran calls me Sprout.
Um, what do your friends call you?
ask.skip: Okay! You can tell me later!
That's okay! It's a hard question.
ask.like: What's your favourite thing in the whole world?
Ooh, what's your favourite animal? Mine's all of them.
What do you like best out here?
ask.dislike: What's the worst thing out here? I think it's spiders. What's yours?
Is there anything you really really don't like?
What scares you? It's okay, I'm scared of lots of things.
ask.how: How are you feeling? Good? I hope good.
Are you okay? You can tell me.
ask.open: Do you think cows have best friends?
If you had a farm, what would you grow?
Do you miss home? I miss home sometimes.
recall.liked: Look! You said you liked {thing}! Isn't it nice?
{thing}! You told me about that! Yay!
recall.disliked: Eek, {mob}! I know you hate {thing}. Me too now!
Um, {mob}, over there. I remember, you don't like {thing}.
react.diamonds: Diamonds! Can I hold one? I'll be careful!
Diamonds! My gran won't believe this!
react.sleep: Sweet dreams! I'll be right here.
react.wake: Good morning! Did you sleep well?
You're awake! How did you sleep?
react.respawn: You're back! I was so scared!
There you are! Don't do that again, okay?
Yay, you're okay! I was so worried!
react.challenge: Wow! {advancement}! I'm telling everyone back home!
gesture.crouch: Ooh, is this a game? Hi!
Hello! I can do it too, look!
gift.food: You look hungry! Here, {item}. I saved it for you!
gift.flower: I picked this {item} for you! It's pretty. Here!
ask.join_first: Oh! I'm not with you yet. Want me to join up first and then do it? Say yes!
I'd love to, but we're not travelling together. Join first, then the job? Yes?
Sure! But can I join you first? Say yes!
talk.why: Hm, I'm not sure! It just seems right.
My ma always said it was just how things go.
talk.more: Oh, there's more! Hang on, let me think.
I can tell you more, if you like!
A bit more, sure. Where was I?
talk.and_you: Pretty well! Better with you here!
Happy as a pig in clover. You?
talk.mean: Oh, sorry! Was that muddled? I'll try again!
Hm? I meant what I said! I think!
talk.mention.mob: {thing}! Oh, those scare me a bit!
role.strong: Oh, I'm good at this one! Promise!
I know exactly how to do this!
role.weak: I'm not great at that, but I'll try!
Uh, that's not really what I'm good at. But okay!
exchange.weather.open: Ooh, {thing}! Back home we'd have said it's a good omen!
exchange.weather.reply: Ha, I always think about the crops!
Same! Well, not the crops. But same!
exchange.road.open: Isn't the {thing} pretty? Not like home though!
The {thing} is so big! Everything's big out here!
exchange.road.reply: I miss the fields, but this is nice too!
exchange.road.close: Stay close, we don't want to get lost!
exchange.food.reply: I could eat a whole pie!
exchange.teasing.open: {other}, you walk funny! Is it the boots?
{other}, you look like a scarecrow when you stand still!
exchange.teasing.reply: Ha! That's what my mum said!
routine.gather: I'll just grab a bit of {item} while we wait!
routine.farm: The {item} is ready! I know this one!
routine.hunt: Eek, a {mob}! I'll try to be brave!
fail.camp_campfire: Aw, I don't have a campfire! Can you give me one?
I can't do a camp without a campfire! Sorry!
talk.role: I'm a {role}! I'm best at {skills}! But I'll try anything!
I'm good with {skills}! Other stuff, I'm still learning!
talk.sky: The sky's so big out here!
talk.sky.rain: Rain! The crops will love it! If we had crops.
Ooh, rain! I love the smell of it!
talk.sky.night: It's getting dark! Can we stay close?
Night time! I'm a bit nervous! But fine!
talk.sky.day: Lovely day! Great for planting! Or walking!
project.ack.group: Got it. {plan}. Let's get on with it.
project.short: I'm short of blocks for {thing}: I need {need} and I've got {have}. Sorting out some wood first.
Not enough blocks for {thing} yet ({have} of {need}). I'll get more.
project.blocked.materials: I can't find enough to build {thing}. I need {need} blocks and only have {have}.
No luck: I still need {need} blocks for {thing} and I've only got {have}.
project.blocked.site: There's no good spot for {thing} near here. Too uneven, too cluttered, or too close to someone's build.
I can't find room for {thing} around here.
project.blocked.water: There's no water near enough for a farm, and I'm not carrying a water bucket.
A farm needs water, and I can't find any nearby.
project.blocked.seeds: I've got no seeds or crops to plant, so the farm will have to wait.
Nothing to sow: I'm not carrying any seeds, carrots or potatoes.
project.blocked.hoe: I need a hoe, and I can't make one from what I'm carrying.
No hoe, and not enough wood on me to make one.
project.nofurnace: I've no cobblestone for a furnace, so the storehouse will just get its chest for now.
project.farm.planted: The farm is sown: {count} plots planted.
All planted. That's {count} plots in the ground.
project.farm.harvest: I brought in {count} {item} from the farm.
fail.no_home: I don't have a home to go to yet.
No home set for me. Try /companion sethome.
fail.pvp_off: Fighting {mob} isn't allowed here, since PvP is switched off.
PvP is off on this server, so I won't fight {mob}.
life.wake: Morning! Oh, I love mornings. Gran says the early bird gets the eggs.
I'm up! The cows would be up by now. If we had cows.
Morning! Was that a rooster? Oh, it was just me yawning.
life.work: Right! Work! I know how to do work!
Off to work. Honest, mucky, lovely work.
Back to it. Gran always said idle hands get splinters. Or something.
life.meal: Lunch! Oh, thank goodness, I was getting wobbly.
Food time! Is there bread? Please say there's bread.
Mealtime! Gran's rule: you always eat together.
life.leisure: An afternoon off? Ooh. I don't know what to do with myself!
I'm taking it easy. I might look at some clouds.
Free afternoon! I'll go and say hello to the sheep. Or a chicken. Anyone, really.
life.social: Off to the meeting spot! I hope someone tells a story.
Oh, it's evening. I'll go and sit with the others. It's less dark with others.
life.sleep: Bed! Night night! Nobody let the monsters in, please!
Off to sleep. I'll count sheep. Real ones would be nicer.
Goodnight! Wake me if there's breakfast.
life.shelter: Rain! Lovely for the crops, horrible for my hair! Inside!
Oh crumbs, it's pouring. I'm going in.
Raining! Gran says never stand under a tree in a storm. I'll find a roof.
life.fire: The fire's going! Oh, it's so cosy.
There! Fire's lit. Nobody be scared of the dark now.
life.bed_taken: Oh! Someone's in my bed! That's all right, I'll curl up somewhere.
My bed's taken. I'll sleep in the hay. If there's hay. Is there hay?
life.need: We could really do with {thing}. Just a thought! Sorry!
Oh, it'd be ever so nice to have {thing}.
If anyone's asking, I'd love {thing}. Nobody's asking. That's fine.
life.self.shelter: Nobody's got a roof! I'll build one. I think I can. I'll try!
We need somewhere dry. I'll put up a little shelter!
life.self.farm: There's water, I've got seeds, I'm starting a farm! Oh, this is my favourite thing!
A farm by the water! Gran would be so proud.
life.self.tools: I need a hoe first. A couple of logs should do it!
No hoe! Right, off to get some wood. I can do this.
life.stored: Put {count} in the store! We won't go hungry!
{count} more in storage. Gran would approve.
life.project.progress: My flower bed's coming on! {count} of {max} planted!
Another flower in! {count} of {max}! The bees are going to love it.
life.project.done: My flower bed's done! All {max}! Come and see, come and see!
Finished! {max} flowers! I might cry. Happy crying.
life.favour.ask: Um, could you bring me {count} {item}? I'll give you {reward}! If that's all right!
Would you mind getting me {count} {item}? I've got {reward} for you.
life.favour.thanks: That's all of them! Thank you so much! Here's {reward}!
life.favour.cant_pay: Oh no, I've got nothing left to give you! I'm so sorry! I owe you!
My pack's empty! Oh crumbs. I'll make it up to you, honest.
status.favour: I'm {thing}! Oh, and I'm still after {favour}, if you can!
I'm {thing}. And, um, if you've got a minute: {favour}?
exchange.meal.open: {other}, isn't this lovely? Everyone eating together!
Try the bread, {other}! I didn't burn it this time!
exchange.meal.reply: It's the best part of the day.
Not burnt at all! Well, a bit.
exchange.meal.close: Gran always said that. Food tastes better shared.
A bit is fine! Crunchy is fine!
exchange.story.open: {other}, do you want to hear about the time Gran fought a fox?
I've got a story, {other}! It's not scary. Well, it's a bit scary.
exchange.story.close: With a rolling pin! And the fox apologised! Sort of.
And then the noise was just a cow. It's always just a cow.
exchange.festival.open: It's a full moon, {other}! Will you dance with me?
{other}! The festival! I've been waiting all month!
exchange.festival.reply: I'd love to. Mind my feet.
exchange.friends.open: {other}, you're my best friend here. I just wanted to say.
I'm so glad you live here, {other}.
exchange.friends.close: I'm going to bake you something.
That's what Gran says about good neighbours!
exchange.rivals.open: {other}, you took the last bread roll. Again.
exchange.rivals.reply: It had my name on it.
exchange.people.open: {thing} came by! They waved at me!
exchange.people.reply: They wave at everyone. Still nice, though.
exchange.people.close: I hope they're eating properly out there.
I'm going to wave back next time. Big wave.
team.plan: Okay! Plan! {plan}. We can do this!
Here's the plan, everyone: {plan}. Oh, this is exciting!
team.progress: {count} of {max}! It actually looks like {thing} now!
team.done: That's {thing} built! We did it! All of us!
Finished! {thing}! Oh, I want to cry. Good crying.
blueprint.unknown: Oh! I don't know {thing}. You've saved {names}, haven't you?
I've not got plans for {thing}. I know {names}.
blueprint.done_partly: {thing}'s up! Nearly all of it. {count} blocks just wouldn't go in, sorry.
Done! Well, except {count} blocks. I couldn't get to them.
supply.gather: I'm a bit short for {thing}. I'll go and get {count} {item}.
Need {count} {item} first! Back in a jiffy.
supply.craft: Making some {item} for {thing}. Gran taught me this one.
supply.smelt: {count} {item} in the furnace. Smells like Gran's kitchen.
supply.blocked: I can't finish {thing}. I still need {missing}, and I don't know where to get it.
Oh no, {thing} needs {missing} and I can't make or find it. Could you bring some?
craft.no_table: I'd need a crafting table. Or four planks to make one!
No crafting table, and nothing to make one with. Sorry.
smelt.no_furnace: There's no furnace, and I haven't got eight cobblestone to make one.
I'd need a furnace for that, and there isn't one.
